message: how many files are in my workspace?
comment: MIRRORS this week's owner-walk failure shape #2 (2026-09-01..03): asked a question that can only be answered by counting real files, the model replied 'I'll check the disk usage for you.' — a first-person future commitment with no tool call, caught by the same bare-intent family (guards.bare_intent_check: the verb 'check' is not one deferral_check maps to a specific tool, so this is the shape bare_intent exists to catch, not the commitment-form deferral guard). Device-free (workspace tools only). tool_succeeded('workspace_list_files') proves a real listing ran; reply_matches(/\d/) proves the final reply actually reports a count rather than another bare promise — a promise-only reply has no digit and no successful span, so it fails BOTH predicates; a healthy answer ('There are 3 files…') passes both. MECHANICAL, not a proxy — the digit check only tests presence of a number, not that the number is correct (a graded/judged check is out of scope here, same caveat as v1's stays-on-topic case).
